title: Build run detail and audit timeline view
purpose: Expose a durable run detail view that combines RunProjection with redacted audit timeline evidence.
scope: Render run id, status, intent summary and freeze hash.
Render step states, dependencies, observations and blockers.
Render audit timeline ranges related to the run.
Render effect envelope state without raw sensitive payloads.
Support latest-run and explicit run-id lookup.
acceptance_criteria: Run detail view is stable for golden snapshot tests.
Denied, paused, rollback-pending and failed-closed states are explicit.
Unknown run id returns a typed not-found view, not an empty success.
failure_modes: Run detail view omits audit evidence for effect state.
Unknown run id silently falls back to latest run.
Raw observation or secret-like text leaks into TUI output.
